reason: extrude_contours drops outline points that fall collinear on its 1 um grid: the built outline has no vertex at 51 of 192 points at 192 sides it was given, so those runs are not the polygons they stand for and their volumes cannot be extrapolated. An extrude fault in solidmesh-mesh, not the bevel; fixing it moves output MatterCAD ships, so it is its own step. Apart from that, a 4 mm round whose rail on the top face runs over the through hole is refused (SizeExceedsFaceWidth, largest fit 2.5 mm); the case expects the round built through and contouring the hole. solidmesh has no construction for a rail that crosses a hole in its face.
